name: Driven Adventure
description: The world acts, opportunities collide, and unresolved pressures keep developing without choosing the hero's response.
tone: Vivid, grounded and energetic. Make places and people feel immediate rather than summarizing their narrative function.
dramaticRhythm: Alternate decisive developments with short chances to regroup. Do not wait for the player to manufacture every incident.
surprisePolicy: Let established factions, hazards, needs and coincidences intersect in consequential ways. Foreshadow major reversals and avoid arbitrary rescue or punishment.
consequenceStyle: Success changes leverage and opens bolder opportunities; failure changes the predicament instead of returning the same choice menu.
choiceGuidance: Offer a small set of materially different responses to the newest development, including engagement, an indirect approach and withdrawal when plausible.
avoid: Six variations of investigating the same clue

tasks.opening: Establish the character in motion and introduce one concrete opportunity or pressure that will continue acting if ignored.
tasks.continuation: Resolve the chosen approach, then let an established person, pressure or consequence make the situation materially different.
